readme: Adjudicated mapping from Recipe Hunter ingredient-queue terms to canonical commodity ids. THIS FILE IS THE RULING, not a hint: promote-ingredient-queue.ps1 reads only what is written here and skips anything absent. A fuzzy matcher deciding commodity identity at runtime is exactly the uncontrolled id assignment the estate guards against - a careless id splits a commodity already priced under another name.

pending_new_id.bacon bits: a shelf-stable topping, not bacon - different aisle, different basis, and reusing bacon would corrupt a live cell
pending_new_id.gruyere: duplicate of "Gruyere Cheese" - one id, not two
pending_new_id.thai chiles: the catalog names chiles individually (dried-arbol-chiles, dried-guajillo-chiles, dried-ancho-chiles); thai is a fourth
pending_new_id.shaved beef steak: a specific cut/prep; the catalog names cuts individually (sirloin-steak, ribeye-steak)
pending_new_id.boneless beef short ribs: a specific cut; baby-back-ribs is pork and is the only ribs id
pending_new_id.fresh oregano: the catalog carries dried-oregano explicitly, so fresh vs dried IS a boundary here (and the per-oz prices are nothing alike)
pending_new_id.cardamom pods: no candidate in the catalog - the only "pods" matches are coffee-pods and laundry-pods, which are false friends
pending_new_id.90/10 ground beef: the catalog splits ground beef by lean ratio (ground-beef-8020, ground-beef-93-7), so 90/10 is a third id, not a rename of either
pending_new_id.unsweetened ketchup: a premium variant; folding it into ketchup would make the ketchup cell look dearer than the ketchup people buy
pending_new_id.tandoori spice mix: no spice-blend id covers it; the "mix" matches are all baking mixes
pending_new_id.almond flour: flour is wheat flour; almond flour is a different food at several times the price
pending_new_id.Monterey Jack Cheese: the catalog has NO block/specialty cheese ids at all (only cottage, cream, shredded, sliced, string) - this is a genuine gap, not a rename
pending_new_id.Gruyere Cheese: same gap; note this and the lowercase "gruyere" entry are the SAME food queued twice and must resolve to ONE id
pending_new_id.Pork Smoked Sausage: the catalog names sausages individually (italian-sausage, breakfast-sausage, smoked-turkey-sausage); pork smoked is a fourth
pending_new_id.Beef Base: beef-broth exists but a base is a concentrate paste, not a liquid - different unit basis entirely
pending_new_id.Egg Yolk: not sold as a separate retail item; the captured price is almost certainly for whole eggs, so mapping it to eggs would publish a wrong basis. Needs a human ruling on whether it is a commodity at all.
pending_new_id.green bell pepper: REVERTED 2026-08-21 by audit-tile-integrity. Ruled a reuse of bell-peppers on the reasoning that the catalog does not split bell peppers by colour - which is true of the CATALOG and false of the PRICE. Promoting Yellow Bell Pepper at $1.99 created a Hy-Vee cell whose stored link is a Green Bell Pepper at $0.79, a 0.4x disagreement, and the guard hard-failed the publish. Colour is a price boundary here even though it is not an id boundary, so these need their own ids or none.
